'''''Aechmea warasii''''' is a plant [[species]] in the [[genus]] ''[[Aechmea]]''. This species is [[Endemism|endemic]] to the State of [[Espírito Santo]] in eastern [[Brazil]].<ref name=q>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=218307 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Martinelli |first1=Gustavo |last2=Vieira |first2=Cláudia Magalhães |last3=Gonzalez |first3=Marcos |last4=Leitman |first4=Paula |last5=Piratininga |first5=Andréa |last6=Costa |first6=Andrea Ferreira da |last7=Forzza |first7=Rafaela Campostrini |title=Bromeliaceae da Mata Atlântica Brasileira: lista de espécies, distribuição e conservação |journal=Rodriguésia |date=January 2008 |volume=59 |issue=1 |pages=209–258 |jstor=23499386 |doi=10.1590/2175-7860200859114 |trans-title=Bromeliaceae of the brazilian Atlantic Forest: checklist, distribution and conservation |language=pt-BR|doi-access=free }}</ref>
